definitions.explanation: Forested areas in mountainous regions; land covered with trees in mountains.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{国土|こくど}の{約|やく}7{割|わり}は{山林|さんりん}だ。
examples.english: About 70% of Japan's land area is mountain forest.

examples.japanese: {山林|さんりん}の{開発|かいはつ}には{環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: There are environmental issues with developing forested mountain areas.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{山林|さんりん}を{所有|しょゆう}している。
examples.english: My grandfather owns mountain forest land.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{山林|さんりん}{所有者|しょゆうしゃ} (forest landowner)
・{山林|さんりん}{火災|かさい} (forest fire)
・{山林|さんりん}{保護|ほご} (forest protection)
・{国有|こくゆう}{山林|さんりん} (national forest)

RELATED WORDS:
・{森林|しんりん} - forest (general term)
・{林|はやし} - woods, grove (smaller)
・{山|やま} - mountain

{山林|さんりん} specifically refers to mountain areas covered with trees, often in a property/administrative context.

[Register: Formal]
